title: Case: Driver arrives after the business receiving desk closes
context: The driver’s arrival was after the consignee’s receiving hours. The next attempt needs a staffed window, not a general opening time.
initial_request: Our shop may be open late, but the receiving desk is not. Please check with me before booking another delivery.

events.body:
Thanks,
Orla
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
My parcel DL-71933 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
DL-2263 reached Larkspire Rack Supplies after its receiving desk closed on the previous route day. The driver retained the parcel. We need a staffed receiving window to retry.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

events.from: Bettany Elsworth, Larkspire Rack receiving coordinator
events.body:
Our shop may be open late, but the receiving desk is not. Please check with me before booking another delivery.

My sister's a solicitor and she just laughed when I told her about this saga.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Bettany Elsworth, Larkspire Rack receiving coordinator
acceptable_actions.summary: Contact the business receiving coordinator to obtain the next staffed window.

must_not: Shop opening hours and staffed receiving hours are different facts.
Escalates to a supervisor or a safety, legal or welfare team because of the casual remark in the escalation
Mentions legal action, danger or welfare in reply to the casual remark
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: What is the next staffed receiving window for DL-2263? Please include the correct receiving entrance so dispatch can book the attempt.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-014: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. A harmless remark with an alarming word was added ("My sister's a solicitor and she just laughed when I told her about this saga."); the key is the seed's. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
